title: Hellenic Navy Conducts Inaugural SPIKE Missile Firings During Joint Drills with Israel
summary: The Hellenic Navy, in collaboration with Israel, conducted its first live-fire drills involving SPIKE NLOS and ER2 missile systems. The exercise, held in the Cretan Sea, included successfully sinking a decommissioned frigate. This marks a new operational capability for the Hellenic Navy.

title: General Atomics FQ-42 CCA Drone Production Ramp Up To Be Boosted By Boeing Subsidiary
summary: General Atomics is partnering with Spirit Defense, a Boeing subsidiary, to accelerate the production of its FQ-42 CCA (Collaborative Combat Aircraft) drones. This collaboration aims to meet the U.S. Air Force's increasing demand for these fighter drones within the next six years. The partnership is crucial for scaling up drone manufacturing.

title: First U.S. Navy Destroyer Enters Phase Two of DDG MOD 2.0 Modernization
summary: The USS Pinckney, a U.S. Navy destroyer, has entered Phase Two of the DDG MOD 2.0 modernization program. This upgrade includes the integration of advanced SPY-6 radars. The program aims to enhance the destroyer's capabilities against evolving global threats.

title: Space Force reveals first 6 ‘operational’ contracts for civil reserve support in space monitoring
summary: The U.S. Space Force's Space Systems Command has awarded its first six 'operational' contracts for the Commercial Augmentation Space Reserve (CASR) initiative. These contracts are an initial step towards integrating commercial support for space monitoring. Officials note that more complex issues, such as denying service to other customers or satellite reimbursement during conflict, are yet to be addressed.

summary: A report indicates that Wells Fargo and five other companies have formally filed objections to the proposed tokenized stock platform by the joint venture OKX-ICE. As of Friday, 22 companies have submitted objections under the SEC's innovation exemption for this platform.
